premises.text: Most educational content is static and linear because dynamic content is too slow and costly to produce while future learner needs are unknown
premises.evidence_span: 98% of this content is both static and linear. Only 2% of it is dynamic. The reason for this is it takes such a lot of time and money to produce

premises.text: Knowledge AI generates interactive bite-sized e-learning packages ~100x faster and plug-and-play ready for any learning environment
premises.evidence_span: generate interactive bite-sized e-education, e-learning packages, 100 times faster, plug-and-play ready for any learning environment

premises.text: Knowledge LX generates full learning experiences for any learning goal in near real-time via a concept latent space between current understanding and the goal
premises.evidence_span: With Knowledge LX, we generate full learning experiences for any learning goal in near real-time

premises.text: Knowledge acts as behind-the-scenes AI backend while LMS partners (Canvas, Google Classroom, Microsoft, Ilias) provide distribution
premises.evidence_span: We focus on being the behind-the-scenes, AI-ready solutions provider, while our partners provide distribution through their platforms

premises.text: Institutions see large cost/time cuts and educators report higher completion and retention from the generated content
premises.evidence_span: Institutions are reporting that it's 100x reduction in cost and time to produce this type of educational content. Educators are reporting a significant increase in completion and retention rates

value.text: Real-time generated learning experiences that match learners' goals and intrinsic motivation
value.evidence_span: a future where we can tap into the learner's intrinsic motivation and generate real-life learning experiences in real time

causal_links.evidence_span: what if we could generate courses in real time
